rv.q: Seriousness of purpose, however, does not make it heavy going, even if Sondheim provided a couple of songs too many. Yes, an excellent Ramin Karimloo never cracks a smile in the title role, but that only gives the blade-wielding barber a nobility that belies his actions.
Two decades later, I was to catch that same revelation again on seeing opera live – no surprise as Sweeney sits more than most shows in the intersection of the Musical Theatre/Opera Venn diagram.
He’s referred to Sweeney Todd as Stephen Sondheim’s “masterpiece”, and you can tell this is a passion project for him in this atmospheric production.
This is a key theme in Sweeney Todd and the way this is visualised on stage is completely thrilling. Pages in the programme explaining the concept of these visuals makes for a very interesting read.
